heading: Definitions
lead: In this chapter, the following definitions shall apply:

tree.heading: Child exploitation
tree.text: The term “child exploitation” means any conduct, attempted conduct, or conspiracy to engage in conduct involving a minor that violates section 1591, chapter 109A, chapter 110, and chapter 117 of title 18 or any sexual activity involving a minor for which any person can be charged with a criminal offense.

tree.heading: Child obscenity
tree.text: The term “child obscenity” means any visual depiction proscribed by section 1466A of title 18.

tree.heading: Minor
tree.text: The term “minor” means any person under the age of 18 years.

tree.heading: Sexually explicit conduct
tree.text: The term “sexually explicit conduct” has the meaning given such term in section 2256 of title 18.

notes.heading: References in Text
notes.text: This chapter, referred to in text, was in the original “this Act”, meaning Pub. L. 110–401, Oct. 13, 2008, 122 Stat. 4229, which is classified principally to this chapter. For complete classification of this Act to the Code, see Short Title of 2008 Act note set out under section 10101 of this title and Tables.

notes.heading: Codification
notes.text: Section was formerly classified to section 17601 of Title 42, The Public Health and Welfare, prior to editorial reclassification and renumbering as this section.
